Question: 令P：天气很冷，Q：老王来了，则命题“虽然天气很冷，但是老王还是来了”可符号化为____
Options A P∧Q, B P→Q, C P∧¬Q, D P→¬Q.
Meaning "Although the weather is cold, but Lao Wang came" is conjunction: weather cold and Lao Wang came. In propositional logic, "although ... but ..." is P ∧ Q. So answer A.
Need provide maybe concise explanation, final line exact format. Ensure last line no quotes.
content:
“虽然天气很冷，但是老王还是来了”表示两个命题同时成立，即“天气很冷”并且“老王来了”，因此可符号化为 \(P \land Q\)。

答案：A
